about_short_description.short_description: Cashify is an online marketplace for reselling used electronic gadgets.

product.name: Used Gadget Buyback Marketplace
product.description: An online and app-based service for selling used smartphones and other electronics through device valuation, doorstep pickup, inspection, and payment.

product.name: Refurbished Gadget Marketplace
product.description: A commerce service for purchasing tested, used electronics, including smartphones, laptops, tablets, smartwatches, gaming consoles, cameras, speakers, and Amazon devices.

product.name: Device Repair Service
product.description: A repair service for smartphones and selected electronics, covering components such as screens, batteries, microphones, back panels, charging jacks, and auxiliary ports.

product.name: Electronics Recycling Service
product.description: A service for recycling old phones and other electronic devices through collection and responsible processing to support end-of-life device disposal.

product.name: Device Discovery and Comparison Tools
product.description: Online tools for finding, comparing, and researching new smartphones, laptops, tablets, and smartwatches before purchase.

product.name: Business Partnership Services
product.description: Partnership programs for organizations and individuals that want to participate in Cashify’s device resale, collection, or retail ecosystem.
